account: The authors of independent clinical studies of OrCam's wearable and handheld text-and-object readers report gains for groups of users and attribute no outcome to an individual. Between 1 July and 30 September 2015, 12 patients with acuity of 20/200 or worse in an ophthalmology department in the United States improved on a 10-item daily-living test from 2.5 to 9.5 with the device at the first visit. They scored 9.8 after a week of use at home (JAMA Ophthalmology, 2016). In a Dutch study of 20 patients with advanced retinal dystrophies (Acta Ophthalmologica, 26 September 2021), the authors found that the OrCam MyEye 2.0 improved near-activity and reading scores after about five weeks. Only three patients kept using it, and the others most often cited other text-to-speech tools such as Seeing AI, the price or missing features. Six patients with stroke or brain tumors at the University of California, Davis, used OrCam Read for a month in 2021 (Neuro-Ophthalmology, 2024). The authors of a five-center study of 100 users found that reading and face recognition improved (Journal of Medical Systems, 2023). At the National Institutes of Health (NIH), nine children with CLN3 disease completed all level-A text, color and face tasks by day five (Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases, 2026). OrCam MyEye 2 and OrCam Read are listed with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as class I electronic vision aids that are exempt from premarket review, so no FDA finding on benefit exists.

fields.account: The authors of independent clinical studies of OrCam's wearable and handheld text-and-object readers report gains for groups of users and attribute no outcome to an individual. Between 1 July and 30 September 2015, 12 patients with acuity of 20/200 or worse in an ophthalmology department in the United States improved on a 10-item daily-living test from 2.5 to 9.5 with the device at the first visit. They scored 9.8 after a week of use at home (JAMA Ophthalmology, 2016). In a Dutch study of 20 patients with advanced retinal dystrophies (Acta Ophthalmologica, 26 September 2021), the authors found that the OrCam MyEye 2.0 improved near-activity and reading scores after about five weeks. Only three patients kept using it, and the others most often cited other text-to-speech tools such as Seeing AI, the price or missing features. Six patients with stroke or brain tumors at the University of California, Davis, used OrCam Read for a month in 2021 (Neuro-Ophthalmology, 2024). The authors of a five-center study of 100 users found that reading and face recognition improved (Journal of Medical Systems, 2023). At the National Institutes of Health (NIH), nine children with CLN3 disease completed all level-A text, color and face tasks by day five (Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases, 2026). OrCam MyEye 2 and OrCam Read are listed with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as class I electronic vision aids that are exempt from premarket review, so no FDA finding on benefit exists.
fields.summary: In independent studies of 6 to 100 participants, people scored higher on reading and daily tasks with OrCam readers; in a Dutch study only three of 20 patients kept using the device.

ratings.reason: Study participants showed measured gains in reading and daily-living task scores. In the 2015 study, 12 patients went from 2.5 to 9.5 of 10 tasks with the device. These are test results, and no lasting change in a person's life is reported. In the Dutch study only three of 20 patients kept using the device.
The authors tested usability in cohorts at several sites and report no societal outcome that can be attributed to the devices.
